headline: Bank of England Raises Interest Rates to 4%, Increasing Tracker Mortgages
summary: The Bank of England raised interest rates to 4%, increasing tracker mortgage payments by an average of £30.72 a month.
why: Central bank rate hikes raise borrowing costs across the economy, impacting consumer debt servicing and housing market liquidity.

impacts.name: Bank of England Base Rate
impacts.why: Official rate hikes directly increase short-term borrowing costs and variable mortgage payments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An official increase in benchmark borrowing costs immediately drives up consumer mortgage expenses and reprices short-term debt instruments.
